definition: someone who buys land to build homes
description: A building site under a blue sky with big white clouds. A young woman in a cream trouser suit, a black top, sunglasses and white trainers stands in the bucket of a yellow excavator as it slowly lowers her towards the ground, holding a small white model house on a board high in one hand and pointing into the distance with the other. Below, workers in hard hats and yellow safety vests stand by a site office cabin, a bulldozer waits, and plots of bare earth are marked out with stakes and orange tape.

taps.phrase: to hold up a model house

es.answer: Está de pie en la pala de una excavadora.
